caption: The drawing depicts a blue, three-dimensional, stylized object resembling a boat or vessel with intricate detailing. The boat has a circular medallion at its center front, with the word "LAFAYET" inscribed around a star and triangular design in the middle. The vessel itself is teardrop-shaped with rounded ends, one end being more pointed and the other end featuring a rounded knob. The sides of the boat feature repeating linear patterns, including horizontal and vertical lines creating a sense of texture, and a row of uniform, semi-circular shapes on the top edge. The drawing is rendered entirely in shades of blue, with detailed shading used to convey depth and dimension, and is centered on a beige background, which is otherwise blank. The initials "M.A.R.S." are visible near the bottom right of the vessel.
title: Blue Salt Boat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
